description: This class manages the lifecycle and configuration of a serial port connection, providing methods to open, configure, and close the port while maintaining thread safety and integrating with binary protocol handling.

classes.name: PortHolder
classes.description: A singleton class responsible for managing serial port connections, including opening, configuring, and closing serial ports, with support for thread safety and protocol handling.

methods.name: openPort
methods.description: Attempts to open the specified serial port, attach a data listener and connection state listener, and initialize protocol communication.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Internal method that creates and configures a SerialPort instance, then establishes a binary protocol connection.

methods.name: setupPort
methods.description: Configures the serial port parameters such as baud rate, flow control, and event mask.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the serial port if open and releases resources.

methods.name: packAndSend
methods.description: Sends a command over the connection, blocking until the message is sent.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of PortHolder.
